attribution: Google default attribution. An efficiency ratio, not incrementality.
todayIsProvisional: Today's row will revise upward as conversions are attributed.
rule: OMNI campaigns optimise store visits; conversion value is a visit count, not rupees. Never graded on ROAS.

creatives.note: Only Search, Display and Demand Gen campaigns have an ad layer. Shopping renders from the product feed and Performance Max exposes asset groups, not ads — so most of this account has no creative data to fetch.
